name: Destroy Kitchen
summary:
Why Destroy Kitchen?
In real life, a broken plate is a tragedy. In VR, it’s a high score. Whether you want to perform a slow-motion kitchen takedown or a high-speed wrecking-ball routine, Destroy Kitchen gives you the tools to unleash your inner chaos.
No Rules. No Recipes. No Regrets.
Tags: VR, Destruction, Physics, Sandbox, Funny, Stress Relief, First-Person.
Satisfying Hyper-Physics: Experience the "crunch" of every plate. Our advanced physics engine ensures that glass shatters how you’d expect.
